mcqs.question: Which groups are specifically prioritised under Andhra Pradesh’s “Mee Intiki–Mee Doctor” doorstep healthcare programme?
options: Pregnant women, children aged 0–6 years, and bedridden persons
Pregnant women and children aged 0–6 years only
Children aged 0–6 years and bedridden persons only
Pregnant women and bedridden persons only
mcqs.explanation: The programme focuses on pregnant women, children aged 0–6 years, and bedridden persons. The tempting alternatives omit one of these three priority groups, so they do not state the complete focus of the programme.
